snippet.title: Geeked-Out Basketball — Official Trailer | Basketball Management Sim
snippet.description:
The basketball management sim for thinkers, not button mashers.

🏀 WISHLIST ON STEAM → https://store.steampowered.com/app/5148870/GeekedOut_Basketball/

Build a program from nothing. Recruit the players, develop them, scout the opponent, write the game plan — then call every possession live. Or sim the full game and watch whether your plan actually holds up.

128 programs. One champion.
Blue bloods aren't born. They're built.

WHAT'S IN IT
▸ Coach every possession live — tempo, aggression, presses, traps, play calls
▸ Or sim the full game and let your game plan do the work
▸ Build your system — playbooks, game plans, training, lineups & rotations, player development
▸ Recruit and win Signing Day — scout recruits, pitch them, close them
▸ Full national schedule, conference races, region and national tournaments
▸ No pay-to-win. Just strategy.

Geeked-Out Basketball is a deep high school basketball management sim — the franchise-mode depth of a Football Manager & OOTP, built for basketball, with a live possession-by-possession game engine underneath it.
